description: Class representing a single sort field within a SortFields collection.

Delete.description: Removes this sort field from the collection.
Delete.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetKey.description: Returns the sort key range (the full table column).
GetKey.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetOrder.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetParent.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetPriority.description: Returns the 1-based priority of this sort field within the collection.
GetPriority.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetSortOn.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetSortOnValue.description:
Returns the value (color or null) by which this sort field is sorted.
For color-based sorts returns the fill/font color; otherwise returns null.
GetSortOnValue.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

ModifyKey.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetOrder.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetPriority.description: Sets the 1-based priority of this sort field, repositioning it within the collection.

params.description: The new 1-based priority of the sort field.
params.name: priority

SetPriority.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

params.description: The value used as the sort criteria.
params.name: sSortOn

SetSortOn.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetSortOnColor.description: Sets the color for color-based sorting.
SetSortOnColor.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
